info.name: AskAnina
info.summary: Your personal assistant: today, calendar, trips and reminders
Je persoonlijke assistent: vandaag, agenda, reizen en herinneringen
info.description:
AskAnina inside Nextcloud: this app shows the AskAnina web app (https://app.askanina.com) in Nextcloud's own page, with Nextcloud's menu and an "AskAnina Today" Dashboard widget. Everything is calculated by the AskAnina service; this app only frames it. You sign in with your AskAnina account. What is sent and stored is described at https://askanina.com.
This app (the frame around AskAnina) is open source under the Apache-2.0 licence. The AskAnina service and web app it shows are proprietary: © Ramin Berwers. All rights reserved.
